meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 你要求发布并给出 patch、minor、major 或具体版本号时,它会触发 GitHub Actions 发布流程并全程盯完:建 Release、写发布说明、尝试发 Discord 公告、核对 npm 包。不做代码复查或修补,除非你另行要求。
howto.when: 当你说出 publish、release、deploy 等发布指令,并给了 patch、minor、major 或明确版本号时出动;没给档位会先停下来询问。

say.text: 帮我发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 触发发布流程并生成补丁版 GitHub Release。
以这个预发版本号运行整套发布流程。

say.text: 发一个 minor 版本,把发布说明写好
say.note: 它会在等待 CI 时起草并写入发布说明。

howto.what_en: On a publish request it triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow and drives it to completion: creates a GitHub release, writes release notes, attempts the Discord announcement, verifies npm packages. No code review or fixes unless explicitly asked.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user says publish, release, deploy or similar release commands with patch, minor, major or an explicit semver. If no selector is given, it stops and asks first.

say_en.note: Triggers the workflow and creates a patch GitHub release.
Starts the release with that prerelease version.

say_en.text: Do a minor release and handle the notes.
say_en.note: It drafts and applies the summary while CI runs.
